segments.speaker: Clinician
segments.text: Good afternoon Mr. Cruz. I see you're here for routine checkup. Any new symptoms or medical history updates?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Well, I don't have diabetes... wait, actually my previous clinic told me last year my fasting sugar was borderline, but nobody started me on Metformin.

segments.speaker: Clinician
segments.text: I see. And what about your daily medications? Are you taking anything regularly?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I take half a tablet or maybe one tablet of something white for cholesterol, but I forgot the brand name and strength. My wife usually manages the pillbox.

segments.speaker: Clinician
segments.text: We will need your wife to bring the actual box. No physical exam today since we need to run fasting blood labs first. Come back next Tuesday fasting.
